project_type: Full-stack monorepo: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript frontend, Node.js + Express + TypeScript + Prisma ORM backend, Python 3.11 + FastAPI ML service, PostgreSQL database
build_system: Frontend: Vite 5 (npm run build → dist/). Backend: tsc (npm run build → dist/), ts-node-dev for dev. ML: uvicorn directly. Root: npm workspaces NOT used — each package has its own package.json. Docker Compose orchestrates all services. QUIRK: backend must run `npx prisma generate` before `tsc` or type errors occur.
test_framework: No existing test framework — greenfield project. Each FEAT's verification is via curl/httpie against the running server or `npm run dev` smoke test. Production build verification: `npm run build` in each package must exit 0.
build_command: Backend: `cd campus-x/backend && npm run build` (runs tsc). Frontend: `cd campus-x/frontend && npm run build` (runs vite build). ML: `cd campus-x/ml-service && pip install -r requirements.txt` (no compile step).
test_command: Integration smoke tests via curl. Each FEAT lists specific curl commands. Full suite: `docker-compose up -d && ./docs/smoke-test.sh` (created in FEAT-007).
verification_instructions: 1. Ensure PostgreSQL is running (docker-compose up -d postgres). 2. Run `cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev` then `npx prisma db seed`. 3. Start backend: `npm run dev` (port 3001). 4. Start frontend: `npm run dev` (port 5173). 5. Start ml-service: `uvicorn main:app --port 8001`. 6. Run demo scenario curls from plan.md.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/prisma/migrations/ — generated by `npx prisma migrate dev`, must be committed. backend/src/generated/ — NOT used, Prisma client goes to node_modules. frontend/dist/ — build output, NOT committed.
environment_constraints: PostgreSQL must be available at DATABASE_URL from .env before any Prisma commands. All commands use Windows PowerShell paths. Absolute worktree path: c:\Users\poorv\OneDrive\Desktop\Projects!!\Major Project\campus-x. Never use relative paths — always prefix with that absolute path.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield — no AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow the architecture decisions in plan.md: single Prisma schema, centralized response helpers, period utility, role-guard middleware.
key_patterns: Greenfield — patterns are defined in plan.md. Key ones: (1) All API responses use sendSuccess/sendError from backend/src/utils/response.ts. (2) All protected routes use authenticateToken + requireRole middleware from backend/src/middleware/auth.ts. (3) Frontend API calls go through frontend/src/api/client.ts Axios instance. (4) All TypeScript interfaces in frontend/src/types/index.ts mirror Prisma output shapes. (5) React pages are lazy-loaded in frontend/src/router/index.tsx.
directory_structure: campus-x/ → root with docker-compose.yml and .env.example. campus-x/frontend/ → React+Vite app (src/pages/, src/components/, src/contexts/, src/api/, src/router/, src/types/, src/hooks/, src/utils/). campus-x/backend/ → Express app (src/routes/, src/controllers/, src/services/, src/middleware/, src/utils/, prisma/). campus-x/ml-service/ → FastAPI app (main.py, models/, data/, requirements.txt). campus-x/database/ → reference SQL. campus-x/docs/ → README, API docs. campus-x/.agents/tasks/ → FEAT artifacts (never in worktree commits).
